_note: Full recipe library — the goal is 200 ready-to-use dinners (steps + grocery list already written) so the weekly job can pull-and-rotate instead of inventing a plan from scratch each week. Built in chunks of 50: ~25% brand-new dishes, ~75% variations/full write-ups of dishes the family already knows or has liked (drawn from core_menu.json, likes.json, and history.json). Each recipe's `slug` must exactly match its photo filename in images/ (lowercase title, non-alphanumeric runs -> single hyphen) — keep `title` and `slug` in sync if either is edited. `category` is 'new' or 'variation'; `coreEntree` links a variation back to its core_menu.json title where applicable (null for dishes not on the original 47). `polo` = true means ≤20 min, eat-then-go, suitable for a polo/quick weeknight. `swapNote` appears only on dishes at kielbasa-level spice or higher, per household rule. Groceries omit day-specific `det` since these aren't week-scheduled — quantities assume ~1.5-1.7x scaling for a next-day lunch per household default. Don't delete this file.

recipes.title: Bratwurst Sausage
recipes.included: Grilled bratwurst with sauteed peppers and onions and roasted mini potatoes.

do: Halve the mini potatoes, toss with oil and salt, roast at 425°F ~25 min, flipping once.
Slice the bell peppers and onions; sauté in oil 8–10 min until soft and browned at the edges.
Grill or pan-sear the brats 12–15 min, turning, until browned and 160°F inside.
Nestle the brats into the peppers and onions to finish.

recipes.lunch: Slice a brat over the peppers, onions and potatoes; reheat together.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Kielbasa & Peppers
recipes.swapNote: Kielbasa carries a little kick — for the teen, swap in bratwurst (a couple links) for a milder sausage.
recipes.included: Smoked kielbasa roasted on a sheet pan with bell peppers, sweet onions and mini potatoes. A family favorite — keep this in heavy rotation.

do: Halve the mini potatoes, toss with oil and salt, spread on a sheet pan and roast at 425°F ~15 min to get a head start.
Slice the kielbasa into coins and the bell peppers and onions into strips; toss with oil and salt.
Add to the sheet pan with the potatoes and roast another 15–18 min until the peppers soften and the kielbasa browns.
Toss everything together on the pan and serve hot.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the kielbasa, peppers and potatoes together in a bowl.

recipes.title: Garlic Shrimp Tacos
recipes.included: Garlic butter shrimp in warm tortillas with crunchy cabbage slaw and a lime crema drizzle. Another proven family favorite.

do: Toss shredded cabbage with lime juice, a pinch of salt and a spoon of mayo; chill while the shrimp cooks.
Season shrimp with garlic, chili powder and salt.
Sauté in butter 3–4 min until pink and just cooked through.
Warm the tortillas, fill with shrimp and slaw, and finish with a drizzle of lime crema (sour cream + lime juice).

recipes.lunch: Skip the tortilla and serve the shrimp and slaw over rice for lunch.

recipes.title: Shrimp Fried Rice
recipes.included: Classic shrimp fried rice with egg, peas, carrots and scallions. A liked favorite — give this extra rotation.

do: Cook 2 cups jasmine rice in the rice cooker earlier in the day (or the night before) so it's cold and dry for frying.
Scramble 2 eggs in a hot wok or large skillet; set aside.
Sauté shrimp with diced carrots until shrimp is pink; add peas and scallions.
Add the cold rice, soy sauce and sesame oil; stir-fry 4–5 min, folding in the egg at the end.

recipes.lunch: Reheats perfectly as-is for next-day lunch.

recipes.title: Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry
recipes.included: Thin-sliced beef and broccoli in a glossy garlic-soy sauce over rice. A go-to quick weeknight stir-fry.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Slice flank or sirloin thin against the grain; toss with cornstarch and a splash of soy sauce.
Sear the beef in a hot wok 2–3 min until browned; set aside.
Stir-fry broccoli florets with garlic and ginger 3–4 min, then return the beef with soy sauce, oyster sauce and a splash of water; toss until glossy.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the beef and broccoli over fresh rice.

recipes.title: Honey-Soy Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.included: Diced chicken thighs stir-fried with bell peppers in a sweet-savory honey-soy glaze.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Cut chicken thighs into bite-size pieces; sear in a hot skillet 5–6 min until browned and cooked through.
Add sliced bell peppers and stir-fry 2–3 min.
Whisk honey, soy sauce, garlic and a splash of rice vinegar; pour over and toss until glazed and glossy.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the chicken and peppers over fresh rice.

recipes.title: BBQ Chicken
recipes.included: Grilled BBQ chicken thighs with corn on the cob and a crunchy coleslaw side.

do: Toss shredded cabbage and carrot with mayo, vinegar, a little sugar and salt; chill.
Boil or grill the corn 8–10 min until tender; brush with butter.
Season chicken thighs with salt and pepper; grill or bake at 400°F ~25 min, basting with BBQ sauce the last 10 min until 165°F.

recipes.lunch: Shred the leftover chicken, toss with extra BBQ sauce, and pile onto a bun with coleslaw.

recipes.title: BBQ Chicken Salad
recipes.included: A hearty main-dish salad — mixed greens topped with BBQ chicken, corn, black beans and cheddar.

do: Sear or grill diced chicken breast 6–7 min until cooked through; toss with a couple spoons of BBQ sauce.
Layer mixed greens with corn, black beans, diced tomato and shredded cheddar.
Top with the BBQ chicken and a drizzle of ranch.

recipes.lunch: Keep dressing separate and reassemble fresh for lunch.

recipes.title: Bulgogi
recipes.included: Korean-style marinated beef, thin-sliced and seared, with rice and quick-sautéed vegetables.

do: Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic and grated pear or apple; marinate thin-sliced ribeye or sirloin at least 30 min.
Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Sear the marinated beef in a hot skillet in batches, 2–3 min per side.
Sauté sliced zucchini and carrots in the same pan until just tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the beef and vegetables over fresh rice.

groceries.name: Soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil

recipes.title: Burritos
recipes.included: Seasoned ground beef burritos with rice, beans and cheese, wrapped in a warm flour tortilla.

do: Rinse 1.5 cups rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Warm a can of refried or black beans in a small pot.
Brown ground beef with taco seasoning 6–8 min.
Warm the tortillas; fill with beef, rice, beans and shredded cheese, and roll tightly.

recipes.lunch: Skip the tortilla and layer the leftover fillings over rice for a bowl.

recipes.title: Chicken Alfredo
recipes.included: Creamy parmesan alfredo sauce tossed with fettuccine and seared chicken, with garlic bread on the side.

do: Boil the fettuccine in salted water until al dente; reserve a cup of pasta water and drain.
Season and sear sliced chicken breast 5–6 min until cooked through; set aside.
Melt butter, add garlic, then heavy cream and parmesan; simmer until thickened, thinning with pasta water as needed.
Toss in the pasta and chicken.
Broil buttered, garlic-rubbed bread 2–3 min until golden.

recipes.lunch: Reheats gently on the stove with a splash of milk to loosen the sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Taco Soup
recipes.swapNote: Keep the taco seasoning mild — set aside a milder, less-spiced portion for the teen before adding extra chili powder.
recipes.included: Hearty chicken taco soup with beans, corn and tomatoes, topped with crispy tortilla strips.

do: Sauté diced onion and garlic; add shredded or diced chicken, black beans, corn, diced tomatoes, taco seasoning and chicken broth.
Simmer 20 min.
Slice corn tortillas into strips and bake or fry until crisp.
Ladle into bowls, top with tortilla strips, shredded cheese and a lime wedge.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well on the stove; add fresh tortilla strips before serving.

recipes.title: Chili
recipes.swapNote: Keep the chili powder moderate and offer extra hot sauce at the table rather than making the whole pot spicy.
recipes.included: Classic ground beef chili with beans, simmered until thick, served with warm cornbread.

do: Brown ground beef with diced onion; drain excess fat.
Add kidney beans, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, chili powder, cumin and beef broth.
Simmer 25–30 min, stirring occasionally.
Bake cornbread from a mix or scratch batter per package directions.

recipes.lunch: Reheats beautifully — even better the next day.

recipes.title: Enchiladas
recipes.swapNote: Use a mild red enchilada sauce, or set aside the teen's portion before adding extra hot sauce.
recipes.included: Ground beef and cheese enchiladas rolled in corn tortillas, baked in red sauce.

do: Brown ground beef with onion and taco seasoning.
Warm the corn tortillas so they roll without cracking.
Fill each with beef and shredded cheese, roll, and place seam-down in a baking dish.
Pour enchilada sauce over the top and sprinkle with more cheese.
Bake at 375°F ~20 min until bubbly.
Rinse 1.5 cups rice, cook in the rice cooker; warm a can of beans on the stove.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well covered in the oven or microwave.

recipes.title: Fish Tacos
recipes.included: Pan-seared white fish (cod or tilapia) in warm tortillas with crunchy cabbage slaw and a lime crema.

do: Toss shredded cabbage with lime juice, salt and a spoon of mayo.
Season cod or tilapia with chili powder, cumin and salt; pan-sear 3–4 min per side until flaky.
Break into large pieces.
Warm tortillas, fill with fish and slaw, drizzle with lime crema.

recipes.lunch: Serve the leftover fish and slaw over rice instead of in a tortilla.

recipes.title: Flautas
recipes.included: Shredded chicken rolled tight in corn tortillas and fried crisp, served with rice, beans and guacamole.

do: Shred cooked or rotisserie chicken; mix with a little taco seasoning and shredded cheese.
Warm tortillas so they roll without cracking; fill and roll tight, securing with a toothpick if needed.
Pan-fry in a shallow layer of oil, turning, until golden and crisp on all sides.
Rinse 1.5 cups rice and cook in the rice cooker; warm a can of beans; mash avocado with lime and salt for guacamole.

recipes.lunch: Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep them crisp, not the microwave.

groceries.name: Cooked or rotisserie chicken — 3 cups shredded
Cheddar or jack cheese, shredded — 8 oz

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken
recipes.included: Garlic-herb grilled chicken breasts with roasted potatoes and green beans.

do: Halve mini potatoes, toss with oil and salt, roast at 425°F ~25 min.
Rub chicken breasts with garlic, herbs, salt and pepper; grill or sear 5–6 min per side to 165°F and rest.
Trim and steam or sauté green beans 5–6 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Slice the chicken over the potatoes and green beans; reheat gently.

recipes.title: Hot Dogs
recipes.included: Classic grilled hot dogs on buns with chips and baked beans.

do: Warm a can of baked beans on the stove.
Grill or pan-sear hot dogs until browned and heated through, ~8 min.
Toast the buns lightly.

recipes.lunch: Reheat leftover dogs and beans; keep toppings on the side.

recipes.title: Kalabasa
recipes.included: Filipino-style pork and squash stew (ginisang kalabasa) simmered until tender, served over rice.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Sauté diced pork with garlic and onion until browned.
Add cubed calabaza (or butternut) squash, fish sauce, and water or broth; simmer 20 min until the squash is tender.
Stir in a handful of green beans or spinach in the last 5 min.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well over fresh rice.

groceries.name: Pork shoulder or belly, cubed — 1.5 lbs

recipes.title: Lamb Chops
recipes.included: Pan-seared lamb chops with roasted asparagus and red potatoes.

do: Quarter red potatoes, toss with oil and salt, roast at 425°F ~25 min.
Season lamb chops with garlic, rosemary, salt and pepper; sear 3–4 min per side to medium and rest 5 min.
Toss trimmed asparagus with oil and salt; roast the last 10–12 min alongside the potatoes.

recipes.lunch: Slice the lamb over the potatoes and asparagus; reheat gently.

recipes.title: Lasagna
recipes.included: Layered beef and cheese lasagna with marinara, baked until bubbly, with garlic bread and salad.

do: Brown ground beef with garlic; stir in marinara sauce.
Mix ricotta with an egg and a handful of parmesan.
Layer noodles, meat sauce, ricotta mixture and mozzarella in a baking dish; repeat, finishing with cheese on top.
Cover with foil and bake at 375°F 35 min; uncover and bake 10 more min until golden.
Broil buttered garlic bread; toss a simple side salad.

recipes.lunch: Reheats beautifully — even better the next day.

recipes.title: Loaded Baked Potato
recipes.included: A loaded baked potato bar — bacon, cheese, sour cream and chives — with a side salad.

do: Scrub russet potatoes, pierce with a fork, rub with oil and salt, and bake at 400°F ~50–60 min until tender.
Cook bacon until crisp and crumble.
Set out shredded cheddar, sour cream, chives and butter for everyone to build their own.
Toss a simple side salad with dressing.

recipes.lunch: Reheat a potato in the microwave and re-top fresh.

recipes.title: Meatball Sandwiches
recipes.included: Meatballs simmered in marinara, piled into toasted rolls with melted mozzarella.

do: Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic and parmesan; roll into balls and bake at 400°F 18–20 min, or brown in a skillet.
Simmer the cooked meatballs in marinara sauce 10 min.
Split and toast the rolls; fill with meatballs and sauce, top with mozzarella and broil 2–3 min until melted.

recipes.lunch: Reheat meatballs and sauce, then rebuild the sandwich fresh.

recipes.title: Meatloaf
recipes.included: Classic ground beef meatloaf glazed with ketchup, with mashed potatoes and green beans.

do: Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, diced onion, ketchup and Worcestershire; shape into a loaf in a baking dish.
Brush with a ketchup glaze and bake at 375°F 50–55 min to 160°F.
Boil peeled, chunked potatoes until fork-tender; mash with butter, milk and salt.
Steam or sauté green beans 5–6 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well; slices also make a good sandwich.

recipes.title: Nachos
recipes.included: Loaded beef nachos with melted cheese, jalapeños, salsa and sour cream.

do: Brown ground beef with taco seasoning 6–8 min.
Spread tortilla chips on a sheet pan, top with beef and shredded cheese, and broil 2–3 min until melted.
Top with jalapeños, salsa and sour cream.

recipes.lunch: Rebuild fresh with new chips so they don't go soggy reheated.

groceries.name: Cheddar or jack cheese, shredded — 12 oz

recipes.title: Pizza
recipes.included: Homemade pizza on store-bought or homemade dough, with sauce, mozzarella and toppings of choice.

do: Stretch pizza dough onto a floured pan or pizza stone.
Spread pizza sauce, top with shredded mozzarella and toppings (pepperoni, sausage, peppers, etc.).
Bake at 475°F 12–15 min until the crust is golden and cheese is bubbly.
Toss a simple side salad with dressing.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well in a skillet or air fryer to keep the crust crisp.

recipes.title: Pretzel Dogs
recipes.included: Hot dogs wrapped in soft pretzel dough with mustard for dipping, plus veggie sticks and fruit.

do: Wrap store-bought or homemade pretzel dough around each hot dog; brush with an egg wash and sprinkle with pretzel salt.
Bake at 425°F 12–15 min until golden brown.
Cut carrot and cucumber sticks; slice fruit.

recipes.lunch: Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep the pretzel crust from going soft.

recipes.title: Protein Bowls
recipes.included: Build-your-own bowls with rice, grilled chicken and roasted vegetables.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Season and grill or sear diced chicken breast 6–7 min until cooked through.
Roast broccoli and bell peppers tossed in oil and salt at 425°F 15–18 min.
Layer rice, chicken and roasted vegetables in bowls; drizzle with a soy-sesame or yogurt sauce.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well as-is.

recipes.title: Quesadillas
recipes.included: Crispy chicken and cheese quesadillas with salsa and chips.

do: Sear or use leftover shredded chicken, seasoned lightly with taco seasoning.
Fill flour tortillas with chicken and shredded cheese; fold and cook in a dry skillet 2–3 min per side until golden and the cheese melts.

recipes.lunch: Reheat in a skillet, not the microwave, to keep the tortilla crisp.

groceries.name: Cheddar or jack cheese, shredded — 12 oz

recipes.title: Ravioli
recipes.included: Cheese ravioli tossed in marinara, with garlic bread and a side salad.

do: Boil cheese ravioli per package directions until they float; drain gently.
Warm marinara sauce; toss with the ravioli.
Broil buttered garlic bread; toss a simple side salad.

recipes.lunch: Reheat gently on the stove or microwave, covered.

recipes.title: Ribs
recipes.included: Oven-baked BBQ pork ribs, low and slow until tender, with roasted potatoes and green beans.

do: Season pork ribs with a dry rub; wrap tightly in foil and bake at 300°F ~2.5 hr until fork-tender.
Unwrap, brush with BBQ sauce, and broil or grill 5 min to caramelize.
Halve mini potatoes, toss with oil and salt, roast at 425°F ~25 min.
Steam or sauté green beans 5–6 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Reheat covered so the ribs stay moist.

recipes.title: Shabu Shabu
recipes.included: Japanese hot pot — thin-sliced beef and vegetables swished in simmering broth, served with rice and dipping sauces.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Bring a light kombu or chicken broth to a gentle simmer in a pot at the table (or on the stove).
Slice napa cabbage, mushrooms and tofu; arrange with the thin-sliced beef on a platter.
Swish beef and vegetables in the simmering broth a few seconds to a couple minutes until just cooked.
Dip in ponzu or sesame sauce before eating.

recipes.lunch: Simmer any leftover meat and vegetables briefly in broth and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Spaghetti
recipes.included: Classic spaghetti with a simple ground beef meat sauce, garlic bread and side salad.

do: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente; drain.
Brown ground beef with garlic and onion; stir in marinara sauce and simmer 10 min.
Broil buttered garlic bread; toss a simple side salad.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well on the stove or microwave.

recipes.title: Stuffed Shells
recipes.included: Jumbo pasta shells stuffed with a ricotta-beef filling, baked in marinara with melted mozzarella.

do: Boil jumbo shells until just shy of al dente; drain.
Brown ground beef; mix with ricotta, an egg and parmesan.
Stuff each shell with the filling, arrange in a baking dish over a layer of marinara, and top with more sauce and mozzarella.
Bake at 375°F ~25 min until bubbly.
Broil buttered garlic bread; toss a simple side salad.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well covered in the oven or microwave.

recipes.title: Tostadas
recipes.included: Crispy tostada shells topped with seasoned beef, refried beans, lettuce and cheese.

do: Brown ground beef with taco seasoning.
Warm refried beans on the stove.
Spread beans on each tostada shell, top with beef, shredded lettuce, cheese and salsa.

recipes.lunch: Keep shells separate and assemble fresh so they stay crisp.

recipes.title: Tostadas Salad
recipes.included: A taco salad served in a crispy tortilla bowl with seasoned beef, lettuce, cheese and salsa.

do: Bake large flour tortillas pressed into oven-safe bowls at 375°F ~10 min until crisp.
Brown ground beef with taco seasoning.
Fill each tortilla bowl with shredded lettuce, beef, black beans, cheese and salsa.

recipes.lunch: Keep the tortilla bowls separate and assemble fresh.

recipes.title: Vegetable Curry
recipes.swapNote: Use a mild curry powder, or hold back the chili/cayenne and let everyone spice their own bowl at the table.
recipes.included: A mild vegetable curry with potatoes, carrots and peas in a coconut-tomato sauce, with rice and naan.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Sauté onion, garlic and ginger; add curry powder and cook 1 min.
Add diced potatoes, carrots, diced tomatoes and coconut milk; simmer 20 min until vegetables are tender.
Stir in peas the last 3 min.
Warm store-bought naan in a dry skillet or oven.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well over fresh rice.

recipes.title: Wings
recipes.swapNote: Buffalo sauce runs spicy — toss the teen's portion in BBQ or honey-garlic sauce instead.
recipes.included: Crispy baked chicken wings tossed in buffalo sauce, with carrot sticks and ranch for dipping.

do: Pat wings dry, toss with baking powder and salt, and bake at 425°F ~40 min, flipping halfway, until crisp.
Toss the crispy wings in buffalo sauce (and a separate batch in BBQ or honey-garlic for the teen).
Cut carrot sticks and set out ranch for dipping.

recipes.lunch: Reheat in the oven or air fryer, not the microwave, to keep them crisp.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Meatballs
recipes.included: Pan-seared beef meatballs glazed in a sticky honey-garlic sauce, over rice with steamed broccoli.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg and garlic; roll into balls and pan-sear or bake at 400°F until browned and cooked through, ~15 min.
Whisk honey, soy sauce, garlic and a splash of rice vinegar in a saucepan; simmer 2–3 min until slightly thickened, then toss with the meatballs.
Steam broccoli florets 5–6 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the meatballs and broccoli over fresh rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.included: Diced chicken fried rice with egg, peas, carrots and scallions — a weeknight staple that reuses the rice cooker.

do: Cook 2 cups jasmine rice in the rice cooker earlier in the day (or the night before) so it's cold and dry for frying.
Sauté diced chicken thigh until browned and cooked through; push to one side.
Scramble 2 eggs in the same pan.
Add diced carrots and peas, then the cold rice, soy sauce and sesame oil; stir-fry 4–5 min, tossing everything together.

recipes.lunch: Reheats perfectly as-is.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Sausage & Veggies
recipes.included: Italian sausage roasted on a sheet pan with zucchini, bell peppers and mini potatoes — one pan, minimal cleanup.

do: Halve mini potatoes, toss with oil and salt, spread on a sheet pan and roast at 425°F ~15 min to get a head start.
Slice Italian sausage into thick coins; toss with sliced zucchini and bell peppers in oil and Italian seasoning.
Add to the sheet pan and roast another 15–18 min until the sausage browns and vegetables are tender.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well together on a sheet pan or in the microwave.

recipes.title: Korean Beef Rice Bowls
recipes.included: Quick ground beef bulgogi-style bowls with a savory-sweet glaze and a cool cucumber salad, over rice.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Brown ground beef with garlic and ginger; drain excess fat.
Stir in soy sauce, brown sugar and a little sesame oil; simmer 3–4 min until glossy.
Toss thin-sliced cucumber with rice vinegar, a pinch of sugar and salt.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the beef over fresh rice; keep the cucumber salad cold.

groceries.name: Soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil

recipes.title: Turkey Chili
recipes.included: A lighter chili made with ground turkey and beans, served with warm cornbread.

do: Brown ground turkey with diced onion and bell pepper.
Add kidney beans, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, chili powder and cumin, and chicken broth.
Simmer 25 min, stirring occasionally.
Bake cornbread from a mix or scratch batter per package directions.

recipes.lunch: Reheats beautifully — even better the next day.

recipes.title: Beef & Broccoli Lo Mein
recipes.included: A noodle twist on the family's beef and broccoli stir-fry — lo mein noodles tossed in the same garlic-soy sauce.

do: Boil lo mein noodles per package directions; drain and toss with a little sesame oil so they don't stick.
Slice flank or sirloin thin against the grain; toss with cornstarch and a splash of soy sauce.
Sear the beef in a hot wok 2–3 min until browned; set aside.
Stir-fry broccoli florets with garlic and ginger 3–4 min, then return the beef and add the noodles with soy sauce, oyster sauce and a splash of water; toss until glossy.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well in a skillet with a splash of water to loosen the noodles.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.swapNote: Keep the garam masala and chili moderate — this can run spicy at full strength; taste and adjust before serving the teen.
recipes.included: Chicken simmered in a creamy, mildly spiced tomato sauce, served with rice and warm naan.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Sear diced chicken thigh 5–6 min until browned; set aside.
Sauté onion, garlic and ginger; add garam masala and cook 1 min.
Stir in diced tomatoes and simmer 10 min, then blend or mash smooth.
Return the chicken, add cream, and simmer 8–10 min until cooked through.
Warm store-bought naan in a dry skillet or oven.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well over fresh rice.

recipes.title: Zucchini Boats with Ground Turkey
recipes.included: Zucchini halves stuffed with seasoned ground turkey, marinara and mozzarella, baked until tender.

do: Halve zucchini lengthwise and scoop out the centers, leaving a sturdy shell.
Brush with oil, season, and pre-bake at 400°F 10 min.
Brown ground turkey with garlic and the chopped zucchini centers; stir in marinara and Italian seasoning.
Fill each zucchini boat with the turkey mixture, top with mozzarella, and bake 15–18 min until the cheese is golden and zucchini is tender.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well covered in the oven or microwave.

recipes.title: Seared Salmon Rice Bowls
recipes.included: Seared salmon flaked over rice with cucumber, avocado and a soy-sesame drizzle — a poke-bowl-style dinner, fully cooked for the family.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Season salmon fillets with salt and pepper; sear skin-side down 4–5 min, flip, and cook 2–3 min more until just cooked through.
Flake into large pieces.
Slice cucumber and avocado.
Whisk soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil and a little honey for the drizzle.
Layer rice, salmon, cucumber and avocado in bowls; drizzle with sauce and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the salmon gently and rebuild the bowl with fresh cucumber and avocado.

groceries.name: Soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Pasta Salad
recipes.included: A cold pasta twist on the family's chicken caesar wraps — great for a quick, no-reheat polo night.

do: Boil short pasta (rotini or penne) until al dente; drain and rinse under cold water to stop cooking.
Sear or use leftover diced chicken breast, seasoned with salt and pepper.
Toss the cold pasta with chopped romaine, shaved parmesan and caesar dressing.
Top with the chicken and a little extra parmesan.

recipes.lunch: Keep dressing separate overnight and toss fresh before eating.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Turkey Burgers
recipes.included: Ground turkey burgers glazed with teriyaki sauce, with sweet potato fries and a side salad.

do: Cut sweet potatoes into fries, toss with oil and salt, and roast at 425°F ~25 min, flipping once.
Mix ground turkey with a splash of teriyaki sauce, garlic and scallions; form into patties.
Grill or pan-sear 5–6 min per side to 165°F, brushing with more teriyaki sauce near the end.
Toss a simple side salad with dressing.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the patty and rebuild the burger fresh.

recipes.title: Baked Ziti
recipes.included: A simpler, family-style spin on lasagna — ziti pasta baked with beef, marinara and three cheeses.

do: Boil ziti until just shy of al dente; drain.
Brown ground beef with garlic; stir in marinara sauce.
Mix the ziti with the meat sauce and half the mozzarella and ricotta; transfer to a baking dish and top with remaining cheese.
Bake at 375°F ~25 min until bubbly and golden.
Broil buttered garlic bread; toss a simple side salad.

recipes.lunch: Reheats beautifully covered in the oven or microwave.

recipes.title: Honey Mustard Chicken Thighs
recipes.included: Baked chicken thighs glazed in honey mustard, with roasted potatoes and green beans.

do: Halve mini potatoes, toss with oil and salt, roast at 425°F ~25 min.
Whisk honey, dijon mustard, garlic and a little olive oil; toss with chicken thighs.
Bake at 400°F ~25 min, basting once, until 165°F and glazed.
Steam or sauté green beans 5–6 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well; also good sliced cold over salad greens.

recipes.title: Baked Lemon-Herb Chicken Thighs
recipes.included: Chicken thighs baked with lemon, garlic and herbs until crisp-skinned and juicy, with roasted potatoes and green beans.

do: Halve mini potatoes, toss with oil and salt, roast at 425°F ~25 min.
Rub chicken thighs with lemon zest, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
Bake skin-side up at 425°F ~30 min until crisp and 165°F.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over just before serving.
Steam or sauté green beans 5–6 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well; also good sliced cold over salad greens.

recipes.title: BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches
recipes.included: Slow-cooked shredded pork tossed in BBQ sauce, piled onto buns with crunchy coleslaw.

do: Toss shredded cabbage and carrot with mayo, vinegar, a little sugar and salt; chill.
Shred slow-cooked or store-bought pulled pork; warm with BBQ sauce in a pot until heated through.
Toast the buns; pile with pulled pork and top with coleslaw.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the pork gently and rebuild the sandwich fresh.

recipes.title: Breakfast for Dinner
recipes.included: Scrambled eggs, bacon and hash browns — a fun, quick breakfast-style dinner.

do: Pan-fry shredded potatoes in a hot skillet with oil, pressing flat, until crisp and golden, ~12 min.
Cook bacon until crisp; drain.
Scramble eggs gently in butter until just set.
Plate with sliced fruit on the side.

recipes.lunch: Reheat gently; eggs are best fresh, so consider scrambling a new batch.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Macaroni Skillet
recipes.included: A one-pan cheeseburger-flavored macaroni skillet — ground beef, elbow macaroni and melted cheddar in a tomato sauce.

do: Brown ground beef with diced onion; drain excess fat.
Add beef broth, diced tomatoes and elbow macaroni; simmer covered ~12 min until the pasta is tender.
Stir in shredded cheddar until melted.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well with a splash of milk to loosen the sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Wraps
recipes.included: Grilled chicken, romaine and parmesan tossed in caesar dressing, wrapped in a flour tortilla.

do: Season and grill or sear diced chicken breast 6–7 min until cooked through.
Toss chopped romaine with caesar dressing and shaved parmesan.
Fill tortillas with the chicken and salad and roll tightly.

recipes.lunch: Keep the salad separate from the tortilla overnight and roll fresh.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan
recipes.included: Breaded chicken cutlets topped with marinara and melted mozzarella, served over spaghetti.

do: Bread chicken cutlets in flour, egg and seasoned breadcrumbs.
Pan-fry 3–4 min per side until golden; top with marinara and mozzarella and broil 3 min to melt.
Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente; drain and toss with a little marinara.
Toss a simple side salad with dressing.

recipes.lunch: Tuck a reheated cutlet into a roll with marinara and cheese for a sandwich.

recipes.title: Fish Sticks
recipes.included: Crispy baked fish sticks with oven fries and peas — a teen-friendly, no-fuss night.

do: Bake frozen oven fries per package directions.
Bake fish sticks per package directions until golden and crisp.
Steam or microwave peas 4–5 min until tender.

recipes.lunch: Reheat in the oven or air fryer, not the microwave, to keep them crisp.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Shrimp & Rice
recipes.included: Garlic butter shrimp over rice with steamed broccoli — quick and rich.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Sauté shrimp in butter and garlic 3–4 min until pink; finish with a squeeze of lemon and chopped parsley.
Steam broccoli florets 5–6 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Reheat gently over fresh rice.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Steak Bites & Potatoes
recipes.included: Seared sirloin steak bites finished in garlic butter, with roasted mini potatoes and green beans.

do: Halve mini potatoes, toss with oil and salt, roast at 425°F ~25 min.
Cube sirloin steak; sear in a hot skillet 3–4 min until browned.
Add butter and minced garlic the last minute, spooning over the steak.
Steam or sauté green beans 5–6 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Reheat gently to avoid overcooking the beef.

recipes.title: Garlic Shrimp Scampi
recipes.included: Garlic butter shrimp in a lemon-white wine sauce over linguine, with a side salad.

do: Boil linguine in salted water until al dente; reserve a cup of pasta water and drain.
Sauté shrimp in butter and garlic 2–3 min per side until pink; deglaze with white wine or broth and lemon juice.
Toss with the linguine, thinning with pasta water as needed.
Toss a simple side salad with dressing.

recipes.lunch: Reheats gently on the stove with a splash of water or broth.

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken Pesto Sandwich
recipes.included: Grilled chicken breast with pesto and melted mozzarella on a toasted roll.

do: Season and grill or sear chicken breast 5–6 min per side until 165°F.
Spread pesto on toasted rolls; add the chicken and a slice of mozzarella, and warm briefly until the cheese melts.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the chicken and rebuild the sandwich fresh.

recipes.title: Grilled Pork Chops
recipes.included: Simple grilled pork chops with roasted potatoes and green beans.

do: Halve mini potatoes, toss with oil and salt, roast at 425°F ~25 min.
Season pork chops with salt, pepper and garlic powder; grill or sear 4–5 min per side to 145°F and rest.
Steam or sauté green beans 5–6 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Reheat gently to avoid drying out the pork.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Tacos
recipes.included: Classic seasoned ground beef tacos with lettuce, cheese and salsa.

do: Brown ground beef with taco seasoning 6–8 min.
Warm taco shells or tortillas; fill with beef, shredded lettuce, cheese and salsa.

recipes.lunch: Serve the leftover beef over rice with the same toppings.

recipes.title: Hawaiian-Style Smoked Pork Butt with Pineapple
recipes.included: Slow-smoked pork butt with a sweet-savory glaze and grilled pineapple, served over rice.

do: Rub pork butt with brown sugar, garlic and smoked paprika; smoke or slow-roast at 275°F ~4 hr until fork-tender.
Shred and toss with a little pineapple juice and BBQ sauce.
Grill pineapple rings 2–3 min per side until caramelized.
Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, cook in the rice cooker.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the pork and pineapple over fresh rice.

recipes.title: Herb-Crusted Pork Loin Roast
recipes.included: A garlic-herb crusted pork loin roast, sliced, with roasted potatoes and green beans.

do: Rub pork loin with garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt and pepper.
Roast at 375°F ~45–55 min to 145°F; rest 10 min before slicing.
Halve mini potatoes, toss with oil and salt, roast alongside the pork the last 30 min.
Steam or sauté green beans 5–6 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Sliced pork also makes a good sandwich.

recipes.title: Italian Sausage & Peppers Subs
recipes.included: Italian sausage and peppers piled into a toasted hoagie roll with melted provolone.

do: Slice bell peppers and onions; sauté 8–10 min until soft.
Sear Italian sausage links 12–15 min until browned and cooked through; slice.
Fill toasted hoagie rolls with sausage, peppers and onions; top with provolone and melt under the broiler.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the filling and rebuild the sub fresh.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Scampi
recipes.included: A brighter, more lemon-forward take on shrimp scampi over linguine.

do: Boil linguine in salted water until al dente; reserve pasta water and drain.
Sauté shrimp in butter and garlic 2–3 min per side; add lemon zest, juice and a splash of pasta water.
Toss with the linguine and chopped parsley.
Toss a simple side salad with dressing.

recipes.lunch: Reheats gently on the stove with a splash of water.

recipes.title: Lemon-Herb Baked Salmon
recipes.included: Salmon fillets baked with lemon and herbs, served with rice and roasted broccoli.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Season salmon with lemon slices, dill or parsley, salt and pepper.
Bake at 400°F 12–15 min until just cooked through.
Toss broccoli florets with oil and salt; roast at 425°F 15 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Flake the salmon over fresh rice and broccoli.

recipes.title: Orange Chicken
recipes.included: Crispy chicken pieces tossed in a sweet-tangy orange glaze, over rice with broccoli.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Toss bite-size chicken pieces in cornstarch; pan-fry until golden and cooked through.
Whisk orange juice, soy sauce, garlic and a little sugar; simmer until thickened and toss with the chicken.
Steam broccoli florets 5–6 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the chicken over fresh rice.

recipes.title: Sesame Pork & Broccoli Stir-Fry
recipes.included: Thin-sliced pork and broccoli stir-fried in a sesame-soy sauce over rice.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Slice pork loin thin; sear in a hot wok 3–4 min until browned.
Add broccoli florets and stir-fry 3–4 min, then toss with soy sauce, sesame oil and a little brown sugar.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the pork and broccoli over fresh rice.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
recipes.included: Classic sloppy joes — seasoned ground beef in a tangy tomato sauce, piled on a bun.

do: Brown ground beef with diced onion and bell pepper.
Stir in ketchup, tomato sauce, brown sugar, mustard and Worcestershire; simmer 10 min until thickened.
Warm corn on the stove; toss a simple side salad.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well; rebuild on a fresh bun.

recipes.title: Smash Burgers & Oven Fries
recipes.included: Thin, crispy-edged smash burgers with melted cheese and oven fries.

do: Bake frozen oven fries per package directions.
Form loose beef balls; smash flat on a hot griddle or skillet and sear 2 min per side, adding cheese near the end.
Toast the buns.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the patty briefly and rebuild the burger fresh.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Glazed Salmon
recipes.included: Salmon fillets glazed in teriyaki sauce, over rice with steamed broccoli.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Sear salmon skin-side down 4–5 min, flip, and brush with teriyaki sauce; cook 2–3 min more until glazed and just cooked through.
Steam broccoli florets 5–6 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Flake the salmon over fresh rice and broccoli.

recipes.title: Maple-Glazed Salmon
recipes.included: A previously-loved family variation — salmon glazed in maple syrup and dijon, with rice and roasted broccoli.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Whisk maple syrup, dijon mustard and a splash of soy sauce.
Sear salmon skin-side down 4–5 min, flip, brush with the glaze, and cook 2–3 min more until just cooked through.
Toss broccoli florets with oil and salt; roast at 425°F 15 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Flake the salmon over fresh rice and broccoli.

recipes.title: Honey-Garlic Glazed Salmon
recipes.included: A previously-loved family variation — salmon in a sticky honey-garlic glaze, over rice with steamed broccoli.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Whisk honey, soy sauce and minced garlic.
Sear salmon skin-side down 4–5 min, flip, brush with the glaze, and cook 2–3 min more until glossy and just cooked through.
Steam broccoli florets 5–6 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Flake the salmon over fresh rice and broccoli.

recipes.title: Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy
recipes.included: A previously-loved family variation on meatloaf — seasoned beef patties smothered in mushroom gravy, with mashed potatoes and green beans.

do: Mix ground beef with breadcrumbs, egg and onion powder; shape into oval patties and sear 3–4 min per side; set aside.
Sauté sliced mushrooms and onion in the same pan; sprinkle with flour, then whisk in beef broth and simmer until thickened.
Return the patties to the gravy and simmer 8–10 min.
Boil peeled, chunked potatoes until fork-tender; mash with butter, milk and salt.
Steam or sauté green beans 5–6 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well; the gravy keeps it moist.

recipes.title: Ground Turkey & Zucchini Skillet
recipes.included: A previously-loved family variation — a quick one-pan ground turkey and zucchini skillet with tomatoes and melted cheese.

do: Brown ground turkey with garlic and diced onion.
Add diced zucchini and diced tomatoes; simmer 8–10 min until the zucchini is tender.
Top with shredded mozzarella and cover until melted.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well as-is.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
recipes.included: A previously-loved family variation — chicken strips and peppers roasted on one pan with fajita seasoning, wrapped in warm tortillas.

do: Toss sliced chicken breast, bell peppers and onion with oil and fajita seasoning; spread on a sheet pan.
Roast at 425°F ~18–20 min until the chicken is cooked through and vegetables are charred at the edges.
Warm flour tortillas; rinse and cook rice in the rice cooker if serving alongside.

recipes.lunch: Serve the leftovers over rice instead of in a tortilla.

recipes.title: Honey-Garlic Pork Chops
recipes.included: A previously-loved family variation — pan-seared pork chops glazed in honey-garlic sauce, with rice and broccoli.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Sear pork chops 4–5 min per side until browned and 145°F; set aside.
Whisk honey, soy sauce and garlic in the same pan; simmer 1–2 min and spoon over the chops.
Steam broccoli florets 5–6 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Reheat gently to avoid drying out the pork.

recipes.title: Lemon-Butter Baked Cod
recipes.included: A previously-loved family variation — flaky baked cod in a lemon-butter sauce, with rice and roasted broccoli.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Season cod fillets with salt, pepper and lemon slices; dot with butter.
Bake at 400°F 12–15 min until it flakes easily.
Toss broccoli florets with oil and salt; roast at 425°F 15 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Flake the cod over fresh rice and broccoli.

recipes.title: Denver Omelet Scramble
recipes.included: A previously-loved family variation — scrambled eggs with ham, bell pepper, onion and cheddar, Denver-omelet style, with hash browns.

do: Pan-fry shredded potatoes in a hot skillet with oil, pressing flat, until crisp and golden, ~12 min.
Sauté diced ham, bell pepper and onion 3–4 min.
Add whisked eggs and scramble gently; fold in shredded cheddar at the end.
Plate with sliced fruit on the side.

recipes.lunch: Best made fresh; reheat gently if needed.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Shrimp Boil
recipes.included: A previously-loved family variation — a Cajun-seasoned sheet-pan shrimp boil with corn, potatoes and sausage.
recipes.swapNote: Go light on the Cajun seasoning, or set aside the teen's portion before adding extra spice.

do: Toss halved mini potatoes and sliced smoked sausage with oil and Cajun seasoning; roast at 425°F 20 min.
Add shrimp and halved corn on the cob to the pan; roast 10–12 more min until the shrimp are pink and corn is tender.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well together on a sheet pan or in the microwave.

recipes.title: Oven BBQ Baby Back Ribs
recipes.included: A previously-loved family variation on ribs — fall-off-the-bone baby back ribs, oven-baked low and slow with BBQ sauce.

do: Season baby back ribs with a dry rub; wrap tightly in foil and bake at 300°F ~2.5 hr until fork-tender.
Unwrap, brush generously with BBQ sauce, and broil 5 min to caramelize.
Halve mini potatoes, toss with oil and salt, roast at 425°F ~25 min; steam or sauté green beans.

recipes.lunch: Reheat covered so the ribs stay moist.

recipes.title: Cajun Shrimp Alfredo
recipes.swapNote: Cajun seasoning runs spicy — season the teen's shrimp lightly (or plain) before tossing the rest in the full amount.
recipes.included: A Cajun-spiced twist on the family's chicken alfredo — blackened shrimp in a creamy parmesan sauce over fettuccine.

do: Boil fettuccine in salted water until al dente; reserve a cup of pasta water and drain.
Toss shrimp with Cajun seasoning; sear 2–3 min per side until pink; set aside.
Melt butter, add garlic, then heavy cream and parmesan; simmer until thickened, thinning with pasta water.
Toss in the pasta and shrimp.
Broil buttered, garlic-rubbed bread 2–3 min until golden.

recipes.lunch: Reheats gently on the stove with a splash of milk.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Salad
recipes.included: The wrap filling served as a main-dish salad instead — grilled chicken over romaine with parmesan and caesar dressing.

do: Season and grill or sear diced chicken breast 6–7 min until cooked through.
Toss chopped romaine with caesar dressing and shaved parmesan; top with the chicken and croutons.

recipes.lunch: Keep dressing separate and toss fresh.

recipes.title: BBQ Bacon Cheeseburgers
recipes.included: Beef burgers topped with bacon, cheddar and BBQ sauce, with oven fries and a side salad.

do: Bake frozen oven fries per package directions.
Cook bacon until crisp.
Form and grill or pan-sear beef patties 4–5 min per side, adding cheddar the last minute.
Top with bacon and a drizzle of BBQ sauce; toast the buns.
Toss a simple side salad with dressing.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the patty briefly and rebuild the burger fresh.

recipes.title: Shredded BBQ Chicken Sandwiches
recipes.included: Slow-simmered shredded chicken tossed in BBQ sauce, piled onto buns with coleslaw — a lighter take on pulled pork.

do: Toss shredded cabbage and carrot with mayo, vinegar, a little sugar and salt; chill.
Simmer chicken breasts or thighs in broth until cooked through, ~15 min; shred with two forks.
Toss with BBQ sauce and warm through.
Toast the buns; pile with chicken and top with coleslaw.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the chicken gently and rebuild the sandwich fresh.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
recipes.included: Tender beef and mushrooms in a creamy sour cream gravy, over buttered egg noodles.

do: Boil egg noodles in salted water until al dente; drain and toss with butter.
Slice sirloin or stew beef thin; sear in batches 2–3 min until browned; set aside.
Sauté sliced mushrooms and onion in the same pan; sprinkle with flour, then whisk in beef broth and simmer until thickened.
Stir in sour cream and return the beef; warm through without boiling.

recipes.lunch: Reheats gently on the stove; avoid boiling to keep the sauce smooth.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Chicken
recipes.included: Crispy chicken pieces tossed in a tangy sweet and sour sauce with pineapple and bell peppers, over rice.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Toss bite-size chicken pieces in cornstarch; pan-fry until golden and cooked through.
Whisk pineapple juice, vinegar, ketchup and a little sugar; simmer with bell peppers and pineapple chunks until slightly thickened.
Toss with the chicken.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the chicken over fresh rice.

recipes.title: Pork Carnitas Tacos
recipes.included: Crispy-edged shredded pork carnitas in warm tortillas with diced onion and a squeeze of lime.

do: Shred slow-cooked pork shoulder (seasoned with cumin, oregano and orange juice while cooking).
Crisp in a hot skillet with a little of its own fat until the edges caramelize.
Warm corn tortillas; fill with pork, diced onion and cilantro; finish with a squeeze of lime.

recipes.lunch: Serve the leftover pork over rice instead of in tortillas.

recipes.title: Turkey Meatloaf
recipes.included: A lighter ground turkey meatloaf glazed with ketchup, with mashed potatoes and green beans.

do: Mix ground turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, diced onion, ketchup and Worcestershire; shape into a loaf in a baking dish.
Brush with a ketchup glaze and bake at 375°F 45–50 min to 165°F.
Boil peeled, chunked potatoes until fork-tender; mash with butter, milk and salt.
Steam or sauté green beans 5–6 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well; slices also make a good sandwich.

recipes.title: Steak Fajita Bowls
recipes.included: Seared steak strips with peppers and onions over rice — fajita flavors without the tortilla.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Slice flank or sirloin thin; toss with fajita seasoning.
Sear the steak in a hot skillet 2–3 min until browned; set aside.
Sauté sliced bell peppers and onion in the same pan until charred at the edges; return the steak to warm through.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the steak and vegetables over fresh rice.

recipes.title: Beef Bibimbap Bowls
recipes.swapNote: Serve the gochujang sauce on the side rather than mixed in for the teen, so they can control the heat.
recipes.included: Korean-style rice bowls with seasoned ground beef, sautéed vegetables and a fried egg on top.

do: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice, add to the rice cooker with water to the line, and start it first.
Brown ground beef with garlic, soy sauce and a little sesame oil.
Sauté julienned carrots, zucchini and spinach separately, each with a pinch of salt and sesame oil, until just tender.
Fry an egg per person, sunny-side up.
Layer rice, beef and vegetables in bowls, top with a fried egg, and serve gochujang sauce on the side.

recipes.lunch: Reheat the beef and vegetables over fresh rice; fry a new egg.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan Meatballs
recipes.included: Ground chicken meatballs baked in marinara with melted mozzarella, over spaghetti — a lighter twist on chicken parm.

do: Mix ground chicken, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic and parmesan; roll into balls and bake at 400°F 15–18 min until cooked through.
Simmer the meatballs in marinara sauce 10 min; top with mozzarella and broil 2–3 min until melted.
Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente; drain.
Toss a simple side salad with dressing.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well covered in the oven or microwave.

recipes.title: Chicken Marsala
recipes.included: Pan-seared chicken cutlets in a savory mushroom-marsala wine sauce, with mashed potatoes and green beans.

do: Lightly flour chicken cutlets; sear 3–4 min per side until golden; set aside.
Sauté sliced mushrooms in the same pan; add marsala wine and chicken broth, simmer to reduce slightly, then swirl in a little butter.
Return the chicken to the sauce and simmer 3–4 min.
Boil peeled, chunked potatoes until fork-tender; mash with butter, milk and salt.
Steam or sauté green beans 5–6 min until tender-crisp.

recipes.lunch: Reheats gently on the stove.

groceries.name: Chicken breasts, sliced into cutlets — 2 lbs

recipes.title: Egg Roll Bowl
recipes.included: All the flavors of an egg roll without the wrapper — ground pork stir-fried with cabbage and carrots in a soy-sesame sauce.

do: Brown ground pork with garlic and ginger.
Add shredded cabbage and carrots (coleslaw mix works well); stir-fry 5–6 min until just tender.
Toss with soy sauce and sesame oil; top with sliced scallions.

recipes.lunch: Reheats well as-is.

recipes.title: Salmon Cakes
recipes.included: Pan-fried salmon cakes with a crisp golden crust, served with a side salad and tartar sauce.

do: Flake cooked or canned salmon; mix with breadcrumbs, egg, mayo, mustard and diced scallion.
Form into patties and pan-fry 3–4 min per side until golden and heated through.
Toss a simple side salad with dressing.

recipes.lunch: Reheat gently in a skillet to keep the crust crisp.

recipes.title: Vegetable Fried Rice
recipes.included: A meatless fried rice loaded with egg, peas, carrots and scallions — quick, reuses the rice cooker.

do: Cook 2 cups jasmine rice in the rice cooker earlier in the day (or the night before) so it's cold and dry for frying.
Scramble 2 eggs in a hot wok; set aside.
Stir-fry diced carrots 2–3 min, then add peas and the cold rice with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Fold in the egg and scallions at the end.

recipes.lunch: Reheats perfectly as-is.

recipes.title: Black Bean & Sweet Potato Tacos
recipes.included: Roasted sweet potato and black bean tacos with a squeeze of lime — a meatless night that's still hearty.

do: Dice sweet potatoes, toss with oil, cumin and chili powder, and roast at 425°F ~20 min until tender.
Warm black beans with a pinch of cumin on the stove.
Warm corn tortillas; fill with sweet potato, black beans, cheese and cilantro; finish with lime.

recipes.lunch: Serve the leftovers over rice instead of in tortillas.

groceries.name: Cheddar or jack cheese, shredded — 8 oz
